description: This circular walk explores the area to the east of the Bedfordshire village of Henlow. You'll visit Henlow Bridge Lakes where you'll find a series of small lakes and fine views of the River Ivel and the River Hiz. It's a lovely area with waterside trails and lots of wildfowl to look out for on the water. To continue your walking in the area try the Henlow River Walk which will take you along the Kingfisher Way to the neighbouring village of Langford .
